names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 29 decembrie, «Sfântul Cuvios Marcel», with the rank words left off; the page it keeps for his troparion names him «Sfântul Cuvios Marcel, egumenul Mănăstirii Achimiților».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 29 Δεκεμβρίου, «Όσιος Μάρκελλος», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s second heading for 29. децембар ст. ст., „Преподобни Маркел, из Апамије Сиријске.“ — «Преподобни» is the rank `venerable` the folder carries, and «из Апамије Сиријске» is a PREPOSITIONAL PHRASE, from Apamea of Syria, and not a by-name adjective, so the bare forename is what is left. THE PHRASE WAS DELIBERATELY NOT TURNED INTO ONE: `marcellus-of-apamea`, the hieromartyr bishop of that city dated about 389 and kept on 14 August, already carries the Serbian form «Маркел Апамејски», and manufacturing the same adjective here would have folded a bishop OF Apamea together with a man merely FROM it. MEASURED BEFORE IT WAS WRITTEN: the bare string lands on `marcellus-15-november`, so the two-member fold key «маркел» is declared in the same commit with both holders read. The monastery of the Sleepless Ones is in the body and not in the heading, and no form was assembled out of it either.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (28 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 29 decembrie — «Sfântul Cuvios Marcel»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 29ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Όσιος Μάρκελλος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 29 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps on the Romanian calendar, and the entry is the same man: born at Apamea in Syria of well-off and lettered parents, a monk at Ephesus, then of the monastery of the Akoimetoi at Constantinople under the abbot Alexander, and abbot there himself. The page gives the century the Romanian life left open — «Ο Μάρκελλος έζησε τον 5ο αιώνα μ.Χ., επί πατριαρχείας Γενναδίου του Α' (458 - 471 μ.Χ.) και βασιλέως του Λέοντα Α' του Μακέλλη» — and the `dates` object here is that century and nothing narrower. It names the patriarch Gennadius I, whom the corpus holds as `gennadius-patriarch-of-constantinople`, and the emperor Leo I; both are named as the years he lived in and not as men he dealt with, so no `related` row is proposed for either, and whether a dating reference of that kind earns one is for the author. It names Jacob, Alexander's successor in the abbacy, who died before Marcellus was raised to it; the corpus holds no folder this reading could attach to him. It adds an alternative the Romanian life does not carry: «Σύμφωνα με άλλη γνώμη, τη μονή Ακοιμήτων, είχε κτίσει αυτός ο όσιος Μάρκελλος, πιθανός στη θέση του σημερινού Τσιμπουκλί» — by another opinion Marcellus himself built the monastery of the Akoimetoi, probably on the site of today's Tsimbukli. That is the page's own hedge and is recorded here rather than in the life as a fact. It prints an apolytikion which names him and is taken. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 11.01.2026 (29. децембар ст. ст.) — „Преподобни Маркел, из Апамије Сиријске.“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry, and FIVE SENTENCES is the whole of it. Identified past any doubt: the heading gives the city, «из Апамије Сиријске», which is the Apamea in Syria the folder’s own life opens with, and the first sentence of the body gives the house — «Игуман обитељи „Неусипајушчих“ у Цариграду», abbot of the monastery of the Sleepless Ones at Constantinople — which is this folder’s display name and its `abbot`. The Romanian and the Greek already keep him on this same menologion day. AND THE DAY’S ONE REAL TRAP WAS CHECKED AND IS NOT THIS MAN: the corpus also holds `marcellus-of-apamea`, whose `office` IS Bishop of Apamea and whose Serbian form IS «Маркел Апамејски» — but that is a `hieromartyr` and `bishop` dated about 389, whom the Russian, the Greek and this same book keep on 14 August, and the heading here prints a PREPOSITIONAL PHRASE and not that adjective. Writing «Маркел Апамејски» on this folder would have made a two-man fold out of a bishop of Apamea and a man merely from it, which is why the bare forename was stored instead. A `death` WAS WRITTEN WHERE THERE WAS NONE, and nothing was replaced: the folder held a `floruit` of «5th century», 401 to 500, off saint.gr, and no `death` at all; that floruit is carried forward word for word and the new `death` is the flat 486, off «Овај свети и славни муж упокојио се 486. године», which sits inside it. `types` untouched: «Преподобни» is the `venerable` and «Игуман» the `abbot`, both already there. WHAT THE ENTRY ADDS, and goes into the life: that he was a seer, a healer and a great wonderworker; that he talked with the angels and beat the demons easily and drove them off; and that after his death he appeared to his brother-monk свети Лукијан and told him he had begged God to take him too into the heavenly kingdom soon. THAT LUKIJAN TAKES NO ROW AND NO LINK: this book gives him nothing but the name and the vision, and whether he is any of the corpus’s Lucians is not a reader’s decision — he stays in the book’s Cyrillic, and it is named in the report. The folder’s one existing `related` row, to `alexander-the-sleepless`, who founded the house this entry names, predates this reading and stands untouched; the new paragraph deliberately does not name him. No `locations`. The Serbian form is the heading’s bare forename «Маркел»; it lands on `marcellus-15-november`, so the two-member fold key «маркел» is declared in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs` in this same commit with both holders read. The Prologue prints no hymn (8 October 2026).

hymns.text: Întru tine, părinte, cu osârdie s-a mântuit cel după chip; că, luând crucea, ai urmat lui Hristos; şi lucrând, ai învăţat să nu se uite la trup, căci este trecător; ci, să poarte grijă de suflet, de lucrul cel nemuritor. Pentru aceasta şi cu îngerii împreună se bucură, Preacuvioase Părinte Marcel, duhul tău.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Cuvios Marcel, egumenul Mănăstirii Achimiților, glasul 8 (the common of a venerable father, printed with his name in it)

english.text: In you, father, what is according to the image was saved with diligence; for taking up the cross you followed Christ, and by your work you taught that the flesh is not to be regarded, since it passes away, but that care is to be taken for the soul, a thing immortal. Therefore your spirit rejoices together with the angels, most venerable father Marcellus.

hymns.text: Ύμνον άληκτον, Θεώ προσφέρων, νουν ακοίμητον, προσφόρως έσχες, προς εκπλήρωσιν των θείων προστάξεων όθεν κανών αρετής εχρημάτισας και Μοναστών ποδηγέτης θεόσοφος. Πάτερ Μάρκελλε, Χριστόν τον Θεόν ικέτευε, διαρήσασθαι ημίν το μέγα έλεος.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ήχος γ', Θείας πίστεως — the only hymn on the page of «Όσιος Μάρκελλος», and it names him.

english.text: Offering God a hymn that never ceases, you fittingly kept an unsleeping mind for the fulfilling of the divine commands; and so you became a rule of virtue and a God-wise guide of monks. Father Marcellus, entreat Christ God to grant us his great mercy.

floruit.note: saint.gr: «Ο Μάρκελλος έζησε τον 5ο αιώνα μ.Χ., επί πατριαρχείας Γενναδίου του Α' (458 - 471 μ.Χ.) και βασιλέως του Λέοντα Α' του Μακέλλη». The page gives no year of birth and no year of death, and doxologia.ro's life, which the folder follows, gives neither either; so the century is recorded and nothing is narrowed to the patriarch's dates, which the page gives as the setting of his life and not as the span of it.

death.note: The folder’s first `death` of any kind; it held a `floruit` of «5th century» off saint.gr and nothing else, and that floruit is carried forward here word for word. The Охридски пролог for 29. децембар ст. ст. closes the entry «Овај свети и славни муж упокојио се 486. године». The year sits inside the century the folder already held, so nothing is replaced and nothing is chosen between. Read 8 October 2026.
